ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This is a blended format course containing face to face sessions as well as online sessions using Elluminate (www.elluminate.com). Students will be required to have high speed internet, working microphone and speakers for this course. Face to face sessions in Oak Brook on 8/27, 9/3, 9/10, 9/17, 9/24, 10/15, 11/5, 12/10. Elluminate sessions on 10/1, 10/8, 10/22, 10/29, 11/12, 11/19, 12/3.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
